title: Chilfa bar Agra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 105b and Tosefta Bava Kamma, end of chapter 9: Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar says in the name of Chilfa bar Agra, who spoke in the name of Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri. In Derekh Eretz Rabbah, chapter 1: Abba Chalfi says in the name of Abba Chagrat, his father. Hyman suggests that these are forms of the name of one Tanna.
